<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `aae2b9e2c371ca4ef5ce3b3a24c3f80d35c25c2b` — the merge of head `8d14c223ba64dbf2d2f2628a139a7de028c130cb` into base `f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin aae2b9e2c371ca4ef5ce3b3a24c3f80d35c25c2b && git checkout aae2b9e2c371ca4ef5ce3b3a24c3f80d35c25c2b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba 8d14c223ba64dbf2d2f2628a139a7de028c130cb && git checkout -B drift-repro f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba && git merge --no-ff 8d14c223ba64dbf2d2f2628a139a7de028c130cb

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f848e3739f36fdfadc58cb4ce07defda6e624cba
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：公开表单 `GET /forms/:slug` 翻译表单视图时，补上 `.custom` 配对包自带译文这一档，与 `/meta/view` 同一顺序（配对包译文 → 覆盖原文 → 基包译文）。
- 为什么改：卡 #34806 的读取那半（裁决 6995998752）。以前匿名访客看到覆盖原文，登录用户在 `/meta` 看到配对包译文。
- 风险与回滚：只影响「视图被配对包覆盖且配对包有该语种译文」的公开表单，其余逐字不变；对象（字段标签）那半不动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`form-routes.ts` 视图翻译调用处新增的 `pairTranslationBundleOf`；新测试文件的 5 个用例，每个都带 `/meta` 对照腿。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `public-form-pair-translation.test.ts`，5 条通过。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、344 行）。L1 意见：可落；三处偏差都接受。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `8d14c223ba64dbf2d2f2628a139a7de028c130cb` · 2026-11-19T02:55Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 4 files, +340/−4, 4 commits. `Fixes #34806` on its own line; #30062, #33952 and #34999 are named with no closing keyword beside them. `check-governed-merges --pr 35290`: 0 of 4 paths governed, 344 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` hold: no spec, metadata key, export or wire shape changes, and the label order was already ruled (6631250894, restated 6942920667).
- **Fixes vs the card:** ruling 6995998752 scopes this card to the READ half and splits the write-door half off, to a separate card only if a reading confirms the gap. The card's own finding (comment 6946122591) is the read half, delivered here, so `Fixes` is right. At close-out on #34806, state that the write-door half was split off by 6995998752 and that its reading is the seat's, so closing the card does not lose it.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34806-public-form-pair-translation.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/rest` (published). Sentences read against the diff: "translates the public form's view in the same label order the `/meta/view` reads already use" = `pairTranslationBundleOf(p, 'view', match.view)` handed as `pairBundle`, the same helper `/meta` asks; "an anonymous visitor read the override's text … (the form's `title` and its section headings)" = the red leg's two strings; "A form view no pair overrides, or whose pair ships no translation for the request's locale, is served exactly as before" = `undefined` ⇒ no spread, pinned by the no-override, no-pair-row and `en` cells; "The form's field labels (the object half) do not change" = the object translate call is untouched.
- **差异由 L1 读过:** one new `await pairTranslationBundleOf(...)` before the existing view translate call and a conditional spread of `pairBundle`; `servedForm` already takes the translated `view.config` when the form is the view's config, so the pair rank reaches what is served. Object block: comment only.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` +1 add-only row, written by `check-engine-double-contract --write` because the gate requires the new test's `findOne` double on the ledger. Generated, gate-mandated, declared. (2) A comment-only edit in the fenced object block: the old text ("this route passes no `pairBundle`") became false with this change, and stale comments are not left behind; the call itself is untouched. (3) The pin is a new file, as the claim placed it: `public-form-section-i18n.test.ts` runs on a protocol double, while this pin needs the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` for the `/meta` control leg, so they share no harness. (4) Model-free commit trailers.
- **Pins:** 5 cases on a real protocol over a real `SchemaRegistry`, each reading `/forms/:slug` and `GET /meta/view/:name` on the same fixture: the envelope reading (A1), zh-CN with pair translation, `en` with no pair row, zh-CN override without pair translation, zh-CN with no override. Red before the fix at `8390e3c7` (1 failed, with the `/meta` control in that cell passing first); ablation of the `pairBundle` spread on the fix: 1 red / 4 green, restored blob == HEAD.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `8d14c223`: 37 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check · debt ledger and all 10 Test Core shards among the successes). Dev local NOT MEASURED ×2: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (prerequisite) and `check:type-check-debt` (timeout); CI's Lint and Type Check · debt ledger cover both on this head.
- **范围外去向:** the thank-you panel copy (`submitBehavior`) is not a confirmed defect: when the form is the view's config, `servedForm` is the translated `view.config`, so that copy goes through the same call with the pair rank. It is unpinned, not broken, so no card is owed. The write-door half is covered under Fixes above.
- **落地条款:** K = 9 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `5262a4c3` (< 15), no locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-3 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34806 with the write-door note above.
